scenes.title: First Day on the Team
scenes.zh: 入职第一天和团队打招呼
scenes.photo: Canary Wharf / One Canada Square / Canary Wharf station
scenes.note: 英国办公室普遍直呼名字，经理说 call me Emma 就别再叫 Ms. Clarke。「请多关照」直译成 Please take care of me 像是需要人照顾，应说 I'm looking forward to working with you。staff 是集体名词，不说 a new staff，要说 a new member of staff。同事约午饭时爽快答应，有助于融入团队。
lines: 经理 (Emma Clarke)
Morning, everyone. This is Wang Lei. He's joining us from today as a data analyst.
大家早。这位是王磊，从今天起作为数据分析师加入我们。
王磊 (Wang Lei)
Hi, everyone. Really nice to meet you all. I'm looking forward to working with you.
大家好，很高兴认识大家，期待和大家一起工作。
经理 (Emma Clarke)
Wang Lei, this is Tom. He'll be your buddy for the first few weeks.
王磊，这是汤姆。头几周由他带你。
同事 (Tom Hughes)
Welcome aboard! Shout if you need anything — I'm just over there.
欢迎加入！有需要就跟我说，我就坐在那边。
王磊 (Wang Lei)
Thanks, Tom. Nice to meet you. Sorry, Ms. Clarke, where should I put my things?
谢谢汤姆，很高兴认识你。不好意思，克拉克女士，我的东西放哪儿？
经理 (Emma Clarke)
Oh, please call me Emma — we're all on first-name terms here. Your desk is the one by the window.
哦，叫我艾玛就好，我们这儿都直呼名字。你的座位是靠窗那张。
王磊 (Wang Lei)
Got it. Thanks, Emma.
明白了，谢谢艾玛。
同事 (Tom Hughes)
Fancy grabbing lunch with the team later? There's a decent place near the station.
待会儿要不要和大家一起吃午饭？车站附近有家不错的店。
王磊 (Wang Lei)
Sounds great. Count me in.
好啊，算我一个。
phr: 他（从今天起）以……身份加入我们；介绍新人的标准说法
I'm looking forward to working with you.
期待与大家共事；代替「请多关照」
有需要就说一声；shout 在这里不是「大喊」
q: 想表达「请多关照」，最自然的是？
I'm looking forward to working with you.
I hope you can look after me a lot.
同事说 Shout if you need anything. 意思是？
I'm a new member of staff.
I'm new staff of the team.

scenes.title: Asking a Colleague for a Favour
scenes.zh: 向同事请教、请对方帮忙
scenes.photo: Raffles Place / Marina Bay Financial Centre
scenes.note: 请同事帮忙时常用 Would you mind...? 或 I was wondering if you could... 软化语气。中国人常说 Please help me check...，在英语里像命令。注意：愿意帮忙要回答 Not at all，答 Yes 反而是「介意」。事后说 I owe you one 或请杯咖啡，是自然的答谢方式。
lines: 周敏 (Zhou Min)
Hey Priya, have you got a sec?
嘿，普丽娅，你有空吗？
同事 (Priya Nair)
Sure, what's up?
有啊，怎么了？
周敏 (Zhou Min)
I'm trying to submit my expense claim, but the system keeps rejecting it. Would you mind having a quick look?
我想提交报销单，但系统一直退回。你介意帮我看一眼吗？
同事 (Priya Nair)
Not at all. Ah, I see — you need to attach the receipt as a PDF, not a photo.
不介意。啊，我知道了，收据要用 PDF 附上，不能用照片。
周敏 (Zhou Min)
That explains it. Sorry to bother you with something so basic.
原来如此。拿这么基础的问题麻烦你，不好意思。
同事 (Priya Nair)
Don't worry about it — it tripped me up too when I started.
别在意，我刚来的时候也被这个难住过。
周敏 (Zhou Min)
Also, I was wondering if you could cast an eye over my slides before Thursday? No rush.
另外，周四前你能不能帮我看看幻灯片？不急。
同事 (Priya Nair)
Happy to. Just send them over and I'll get back to you by tomorrow.
乐意帮忙。发给我吧，我明天前回复你。
周敏 (Zhou Min)
Thanks a million. I owe you a coffee.
太感谢了，我欠你一杯咖啡。
phr: 你有空吗？（打扰别人前的开场）
Would you mind having a quick look?
I was wondering if you could ...
不知道你能不能……；比 Can you 更委婉
I owe you one. / I owe you a coffee.
欠你个人情／欠你一杯咖啡
q: 对方问 Would you mind having a look? 你愿意帮忙，应回答？
Not at all. Send it over.
Which request sounds the most polite?
I was wondering if you could review my slides.
Please help me check my slides.
It tripped me up too. 的意思是？
我当初也被这个难住过

scenes.title: Taking a Message
scenes.note: 接电话先报公司名，再说「名字 + speaking」。问对方是谁时说 Who are you? 很失礼，应说 May I ask who's calling?。同事不在时别说 He is not here，用 I'm afraid he's in a meeting 更客气。姓名和号码要请对方拼写，并复述确认（Let me read that back）。
lines: 刘洋 (Liu Yang)
Good morning, Kestrel Software, Liu Yang speaking.
早上好，凯斯特软件公司，我是刘洋。
来电者 (Diane Ross)
Hi, could I speak to Mark Bennett, please?
你好，请找马克·贝内特。
刘洋 (Liu Yang)
I'm afraid Mark's in a meeting at the moment. Can I take a message?
不好意思，马克正在开会。需要我帮您留言吗？
来电者 (Diane Ross)
Yes, please. This is Diane Ross from Parkside Media. It's about the contract renewal.
好的。我是帕克赛德传媒的黛安·罗斯，是关于续约的事。
刘洋 (Liu Yang)
Sorry, could you spell your last name for me?
不好意思，能拼一下您的姓吗？
来电者 (Diane Ross)
Sure, it's R-O-S-S.
好的，R-O-S-S。
刘洋 (Liu Yang)
Thanks. And what's the best number to reach you on?
谢谢。打哪个号码最容易找到您？
来电者 (Diane Ross)
212-555-0148. I'm free any time after three.
刘洋 (Liu Yang)
Let me read that back: Diane Ross, Parkside Media, 212-555-0148, after 3 p.m. I'll make sure he gets the message.
我复述一下：黛安·罗斯，帕克赛德传媒，212-555-0148，下午三点以后。我一定转告他。
来电者 (Diane Ross)
Great, thanks for your help.
太好了，谢谢。
phr: 接电话自报公司和姓名
I'm afraid he's in a meeting at the moment.
Could you spell that for me?
What's the best number to reach you on?
打哪个号码能联系到您？
q: 想问来电者是谁，最得体的是？
接电话时自报姓名，正确的是？
Can I take a message? 的意思是？

scenes.title: A Bad Line on a Call
scenes.zh: 通话信号差时确认信息
scenes.photo: Singapore Central Business District / Shenton Way
scenes.note: 跨国电话常信号不好。听不清时别说 What? 或 Repeat，要说 Sorry, could you say that again?。My signal is not good 不够地道，可说 The line's bad 或 You're breaking up。日期、数字、地名要复述确认，事后再发邮件留底，确保双方信息一致（on the same page）。
lines: 陈宇 (Chen Yu)
Hi James, can you hear me okay?
嗨，詹姆斯，你听得清吗？
客户 (James Porter)
You're breaking up a bit, Chen. Could you say that again?
陈，你的声音有点断断续续。能再说一遍吗？
陈宇 (Chen Yu)
Sorry, the line's not great. I said the shipment left Singapore on Monday.
抱歉，线路不太好。我是说货周一已经从新加坡发出了。
客户 (James Porter)
Got it — Monday. And when's it due in Felixstowe?
明白，周一。那预计什么时候到费利克斯托？
陈宇 (Chen Yu)
Around the 14th. Sorry, you cut out for a second there. Did you say Felixstowe?
大概 14 号。不好意思，刚才你的声音断了一下。你说的是费利克斯托吗？
客户 (James Porter)
Yes, Felixstowe. Look, why don't I call you back on a landline?
对，费利克斯托。这样吧，我用座机给你回拨过去？
陈宇 (Chen Yu)
Good idea. In the meantime, I'll drop you an email with the tracking details so we're on the same page.
好主意。同时我给你发封邮件，附上物流追踪信息，免得我们信息不一致。
客户 (James Porter)
Perfect. Speak in five.
好极了，五分钟后聊。
phr: You cut out for a second there.
刚才你的声音断了一下
Sorry, could you say that again?
不好意思，能再说一遍吗？
Why don't I call you back?
so we're on the same page
q: You're breaking up. 的意思是？
听不清对方时，最得体的说法是？
Sorry, could you say that again?
so we're on the same page 的意思是？
以便我们看同一页文件
以便我们签同一份合同

scenes.title: Checking In at Reception
scenes.zh: 拜访客户公司时在前台报到
scenes.photo: The Shard London / London Bridge station
scenes.note: 到前台先说清约了谁、几点、自己是哪家公司。I want to find Rachel 或 I come to see Rachel 很生硬，应说 I have a two o'clock meeting with Rachel Moore。拒绝饮品说 I'm fine, thanks，不要说 No, I don't want。英国说 lift，美国说 elevator。
lines: 前台 (Receptionist)
Good afternoon. How can I help?
下午好，有什么可以帮您？
张辉 (Zhang Hui)
Hi, I have a two o'clock meeting with Rachel Moore. My name's Zhang Hui, from Brightwell Logistics.
您好，我和瑞秋·摩尔约了两点开会。我叫张辉，来自布莱特维尔物流。
前台 (Receptionist)
Let me just check... Yes, she's expecting you. Could you sign in here, please?
我查一下……是的，她在等您。请在这里登记一下。
张辉 (Zhang Hui)
Sure. Do you need to see some ID?
好的。需要看证件吗？
前台 (Receptionist)
Just a photo ID, thanks. Here's your visitor pass — please wear it at all times.
带照片的证件就行，谢谢。这是您的访客证，请全程佩戴。
张辉 (Zhang Hui)
No problem. Which floor is it?
没问题。在几楼？
前台 (Receptionist)
The thirty-second. Take the lifts on your left, and Rachel will meet you there. Can I get you some water before you go up?
32 楼。请乘左边的电梯，瑞秋会在那里接您。上去之前要喝点水吗？
张辉 (Zhang Hui)
I'm fine, thanks. I'll head up now.
不用了，谢谢。我现在上去。
phr: I have a (two o'clock) meeting with ...
Could you sign in here, please?
Take the lifts on your left.
乘左边的电梯（美式 elevators）
q: 在前台说明来意，最自然的是？
I have a two o'clock meeting with Rachel Moore.
I want to find Rachel Moore.
I come to see Rachel Moore at two.
前台问 Can I get you anything? 礼貌地拒绝应说？
英式英语的 lift 在美式英语里是？

scenes.title: Showing a Client Around
scenes.zh: 接待来访客户并参观办公室
scenes.note: 接待客户先寒暄旅途（How was the flight?），别一见面就谈生意。Have you eaten? 在英语里像要请对方吃饭。Welcome to our company to visit 是 Chinglish，说 Great to have you here 即可。参观时用 This is... 介绍，再用 Shall we go through? 引向会议室。
lines: 黄杰 (Huang Jie)
Daniel, great to see you again. How was the flight?
丹尼尔，很高兴再见到你。航班还顺利吗？
客户 (Daniel Fischer)
Not bad at all, thanks. A bit of turbulence, but I managed to get some sleep.
挺好的，谢谢。有点颠簸，不过还睡了一会儿。
黄杰 (Huang Jie)
Glad to hear it. Before we head into the meeting, can I give you a quick tour?
那就好。开会之前，我带你简单参观一下？
客户 (Daniel Fischer)
I'd love that.
好啊。
黄杰 (Huang Jie)
This is our open-plan area — most of the sales team sits here. And through here is the test kitchen, where we develop new recipes.
这是开放式办公区，销售团队大部分在这儿。这边进去是试验厨房，我们在这里研发新菜谱。
客户 (Daniel Fischer)
Wow, impressive set-up. How many people do you have here now?
哇，配置真不错。你们这里现在有多少人？
黄杰 (Huang Jie)
Just under eighty, and we're hoping to double that by next year.
将近八十人，希望明年翻一番。
客户 (Daniel Fischer)
That's quite a growth plan.
这个增长计划不小啊。
黄杰 (Huang Jie)
It is. Right, shall we go through? Can I get you a coffee or tea first?
是的。好，我们进会议室吧？先给你来杯咖啡还是茶？
客户 (Daniel Fischer)
A flat white would be great, thanks.
来杯馥芮白就好，谢谢。
phr: Can I give you a quick tour?
q: 客户刚到，最自然的寒暄是？
Welcome to our company to visit.
Shall we go through? 在这里的意思是？

scenes.title: Running the Weekly Meeting
scenes.note: 主持会议要开场说明议程和时长，逐项推进（First up / Moving on to...），结尾总结行动事项。discuss 是及物动词，不说 discuss about the budget。有人跑题时用 Let's take that offline（会后单独谈），不是「下线」。插话用 Sorry, can I just jump in here? 比直接打断礼貌。
lines: 李娜 (Li Na)
Okay, let's get started. Thanks for coming, everyone. We've got three items on the agenda, so I'll try to keep it to thirty minutes.
好，我们开始吧。谢谢大家参加。今天议程有三项，我尽量控制在三十分钟内。
李娜 (Li Na)
First up, the Q3 campaign. Ben, could you give us a quick update?
第一项，第三季度推广活动。本，你简单汇报一下进展？
同事 (Ben Carter)
Sure. We're about 80% done. The only thing holding us up is final sign-off from Legal.
好的。我们完成了大约八成，唯一卡住的是法务的最终审批。
李娜 (Li Na)
Okay. Can you chase them and let me know by Wednesday?
好。你能催一下他们，周三前告诉我结果吗？
同事 (Ben Carter)
Will do.
没问题。
同事 (Sophie Wu)
Sorry, can I just jump in here? If Legal needs more time, it'll push back the launch date.
不好意思，我插一句。如果法务需要更多时间，上线日期就得推迟。
李娜 (Li Na)
Good point. Let's take that offline after the meeting so we stay on track. Moving on to item two — the budget.
说得好。这个我们会后单独谈，免得跑题。下面进入第二项：预算。
李娜 (Li Na)
Okay, I think that's everything. To sum up: Ben's chasing Legal, and Sophie's drafting a backup timeline. Thanks, everyone.
好，差不多就这些。总结一下：本去催法务，索菲起草一份备用时间表。谢谢大家。
phr: 第一项是…… ／ 下面进入……
The only thing holding us up is ...
Can I just jump in here?
q: Let's take that offline. 的意思是？
想在别人发言时礼貌地插话，可以说？
Sorry, can I just jump in here?
You are wrong, let me speak.

scenes.title: Disagreeing Diplomatically
scenes.zh: 在会上委婉地提出不同意见
scenes.note: 英国职场提反对意见讲究「先肯定、再转折」，用 not entirely、I'm not sure 弱化语气。直接说 Your idea is wrong 会显得很冲。另一个常见问题是会上沉默、会后抱怨，在外企会被看作不投入。最受欢迎的是提出替代方案（What if we...?）。I could live with that 表示「可以接受」，略带勉强。
lines: 总监 (Oliver Grant)
So the proposal is to move all first-line support to the chatbot by January. Any thoughts?
提案是一月前把所有一线客服转给聊天机器人。大家有什么想法？
徐静 (Xu Jing)
I can see the logic in cutting costs, but I'm not entirely convinced the timing is right.
我理解降低成本的思路，但我不太确定现在时机合适。
总监 (Oliver Grant)
Go on.
你接着说。
徐静 (Xu Jing)
Our latest survey shows that about 40% of complaints come from older customers who prefer talking to a person. If we switch over too quickly, we risk losing some of them.
最新调查显示，大约四成投诉来自更喜欢和真人沟通的年长客户。切换太快的话，可能会流失一部分客户。
同事 (Hannah Price)
That's a fair point, but we can't afford to keep the current team at full size.
有道理，但我们负担不起维持现有团队的全部规模。
徐静 (Xu Jing)
I agree we need to bring costs down. What if we ran a pilot with one product line first and reviewed the numbers in March?
我同意需要降成本。我们先在一条产品线上试点，三月再看数据，怎么样？
总监 (Oliver Grant)
Hmm, I'd be open to that. Hannah, would a phased approach work for you?
嗯，我可以考虑。汉娜，分阶段推进你能接受吗？
同事 (Hannah Price)
I could live with that, as long as we have a clear cut-off date.
可以接受，只要有明确的截止日期。
总监 (Oliver Grant)
Right, let's go with a pilot. Xu Jing, could you put together a proposal by Friday?
好，就先试点。徐静，你周五前能整理一份方案吗？
phr: I can see the logic in ..., but ...
我理解……的思路，但……（先肯定再转折）
我们……怎么样？（提出替代方案）
q: Which is the most diplomatic way to disagree?
I'm not entirely convinced that's the right approach.
I don't agree with you at all.
I could live with that. 的意思是？
提出替代方案时，较自然的表达是？
What if we ran a pilot first?
You should listen to my plan.
My plan is better than yours.

scenes.title: Flagging a Delay
scenes.photo: Raffles Place MRT station / Singapore skyline
scenes.note: 汇报坏消息要先说结论和影响，再说已采取的对策，不要只把问题抛给领导。中国员工常拖到最后才说，或用 maybe a small problem 绕圈子。give you a heads-up 是「提前打招呼」，keep someone in the loop 是「随时同步」，copy you in 即邮件抄送。inform 后直接接人，不说 inform to the client。
lines: 林涛 (Lin Tao)
Hi Grace, do you have five minutes? I wanted to give you a heads-up about the Marina project.
嗨，格蕾丝，你有五分钟吗？我想先跟你说一下 Marina 项目的情况。
经理 (Grace Tan)
Sure, what's going on?
好啊，怎么了？
林涛 (Lin Tao)
The supplier has just told us the server hardware won't arrive until the 20th, so we're looking at about a week's delay.
供应商刚通知，服务器硬件要 20 号才能到，所以大概会延误一周。
经理 (Grace Tan)
Hmm, that's not ideal. Does that affect the client go-live?
嗯，这可不太妙。会影响客户上线吗？
林涛 (Lin Tao)
It might. But I've already spoken to the vendor, and they can loan us two units in the meantime. That would let us start testing on schedule.
有可能。不过我已经和供应商谈过，他们可以先借我们两台，这样测试能按计划开始。
经理 (Grace Tan)
Good thinking. Are there any extra costs?
想得周到。有额外费用吗？
林涛 (Lin Tao)
Around two thousand dollars, which is still within our contingency budget.
大约两千新元，还在应急预算之内。
经理 (Grace Tan)
Okay, go ahead. And keep the client in the loop — I'd rather they hear it from us.
好，就这么办。随时和客户同步，我宁可他们从我们这里听到消息。
林涛 (Lin Tao)
Absolutely. I'll send them an update this afternoon and copy you in.
当然。我今天下午给他们发更新，抄送给你。
phr: I wanted to give you a heads-up about ...
We're looking at about a week's delay.
这不太妙（委婉表达不满）
q: give you a heads-up 的意思是？
I'll inform the client this afternoon.
I'll inform to the client this afternoon.
I'll inform with the client this afternoon.
I'll informing the client this afternoon.
向上级汇报延误时，最好的做法是？
先说结论和影响，再提出解决方案
先道歉很久再慢慢说问题
只发一句 There is a problem.

scenes.title: Pushing Back on Extra Work
scenes.note: 在外企，拒绝额外工作是正常的，关键是给出具体理由和替代方案。中国员工常见两种极端：一是什么都答应 OK, no problem，结果做不完；二是直接说 I can't, I'm busy，显得生硬。I'm very busy 太笼统，说清手上的任务和截止日期更有说服力。bandwidth 原指带宽，职场里指「余力」；be upfront 是「坦率地提前说明」。
lines: 经理 (Mike Saunders)
Sun Qian, could you take on the vendor review as well? It's only a couple of days' work.
孙倩，供应商评估你也能接一下吗？就两三天的工作量。
孙倩 (Sun Qian)
I'd really like to help, but I'm at full capacity with the audit until the end of the month.
我很想帮忙，但月底之前审计已经让我忙满了。
经理 (Mike Saunders)
I know it's a busy period. Is there no way you could squeeze it in?
我知道这段时间很忙。真的挤不出时间吗？
孙倩 (Sun Qian)
If I take it on now, I'm worried the audit would slip, and that has a hard deadline. Could we look at priorities together?
如果现在接下来，我担心审计会延误，而审计的截止日期是硬性的。我们能一起看看优先级吗？
经理 (Mike Saunders)
Fair enough. Which would you say is more urgent?
有道理。你觉得哪个更急？
孙倩 (Sun Qian)
The audit, definitely. But I could pick up the vendor review from the 1st, or you could ask Raj — he mentioned he has some bandwidth this week.
肯定是审计。不过我可以从 1 号开始接供应商评估，或者你问问拉吉，他说这周有点余力。
经理 (Mike Saunders)
Let me check with Raj, then. Thanks for being upfront about it.
那我问问拉吉。谢谢你坦白说明。
孙倩 (Sun Qian)
Of course. I'd rather flag it now than let you down later.
应该的。我宁可现在说清楚，也不想之后让你失望。
phr: I'd really like to help, but ...
Could we look at priorities together?
我们能一起看看优先级吗？
q: I'm at full capacity. 的意思是？
我手上的工作已经满了
拒绝额外任务时，最得体的是？
I'd really like to help, but I'm tied up with the audit until the 30th.
He has some bandwidth this week. 中的 bandwidth 指？

scenes.title: Pitching to a New Client
scenes.note: 美式推销讲究先确认客户的需求（pain point），再用具体数据和案例说明你能解决什么。中国销售常犯的错误是一上来就念产品参数，或者说 Our product is the best in the world，显得夸大、不可信。客户问价格时常说 investment；介绍价格优势要说 cost-effective 或 affordable，cheap 带有「廉价、质量差」的意味。
lines: 高飞 (Gao Fei)
Thanks for making the time, Linda. I know you're busy, so I'll keep it brief.
琳达，谢谢你抽出时间。我知道你很忙，我长话短说。
客户 (Linda Park)
Appreciate that. So, what can you do for us?
谢谢。那么，你们能为我们做什么？
高飞 (Gao Fei)
From what you told me on the phone, your stores often run out of best-sellers while slow-moving items pile up in the warehouse. Is that still the main pain point?
根据你电话里说的，你们门店经常畅销品断货，而滞销品在仓库里堆积。这还是主要痛点吗？
客户 (Linda Park)
Pretty much, yes.
基本上是的。
高飞 (Gao Fei)
Our system forecasts demand store by store. One of our clients, a chain about your size, cut stock-outs by around 30% in six months.
我们的系统能按门店预测需求。我们有个客户，规模和你们差不多的连锁店，六个月内断货减少了约三成。
客户 (Linda Park)
That sounds good on paper, but how long does it take to set up?
理论上听着不错，但部署要多久？
高飞 (Gao Fei)
Typically six to eight weeks, and we handle the data migration for you.
一般六到八周，数据迁移由我们负责。
客户 (Linda Park)
And what kind of investment are we talking about?
那大概需要投入多少？
高飞 (Gao Fei)
It depends on the number of stores, but I can put together a tailored quote. Would it help if we set up a free trial for, say, five stores first?
取决于门店数量，我可以做一份定制报价。要不先给比如五家门店做个免费试用？
客户 (Linda Park)
That could work. Send me the details.
可以考虑。把详细资料发给我吧。
phr: That sounds good on paper, but ...
What kind of investment are we talking about?
大概要投入多少？（委婉问价）
如果我们……会不会有帮助？
q: 描述价格优势时，更合适的词是？
That sounds good on paper. 暗示说话人？
听起来不错，但还有疑虑

scenes.title: Negotiating Price and Terms
scenes.note: 英国人谈判语气含蓄，常用 a bit、To be honest 软化。让步要有交换条件（If we..., would you...?），不要一味砍价。price 只能说 high / low，不说 Your price is too expensive。想要降价可问 Is there any room to move on price?。meet halfway 即「各让一步」。
lines: 供应商 (Claire Dawson)
So, based on 50,000 units, our price would be £1.20 per unit.
按五万件算，我们的单价是 1.20 英镑。
何明 (He Ming)
Thanks, Claire. To be honest, that's a bit higher than we'd budgeted for. We were thinking more along the lines of £1.05.
谢谢，克莱尔。说实话，这比我们的预算高了一些。我们原本考虑的是 1.05 英镑左右。
供应商 (Claire Dawson)
I understand, but our material costs have gone up quite a bit this year. £1.05 would be very difficult for us.
我理解，但今年我们的材料成本涨了不少。1.05 英镑对我们来说很难。
何明 (He Ming)
I appreciate that. What if we committed to a twelve-month contract instead of six? Would that give you some room to move on price?
我理解。如果我们签十二个月而不是六个月的合同呢？价格上会不会有些空间？
供应商 (Claire Dawson)
A longer commitment would definitely help. I could come down to £1.12.
更长的合约肯定有帮助。我可以降到 1.12 英镑。
何明 (He Ming)
That's a step in the right direction. Could we meet halfway at £1.10 if we also agree to 30-day payment terms instead of 60?
这是个好的开始。如果我们把付款期从 60 天缩短到 30 天，能不能各让一步，定在 1.10 英镑？
供应商 (Claire Dawson)
Faster payment would help our cash flow... All right — £1.10, 30-day terms and a twelve-month contract. We have a deal.
更快付款对我们的现金流有帮助……好吧，1.10 英镑，30 天付款，十二个月合同。成交。
何明 (He Ming)
Great. I'll get our legal team to draw up the paperwork, and we'll aim to have it signed by the end of the month.
太好了。我让法务起草文件，争取月底前签好。
phr: 大概在……左右（提出己方期望）
That's a step in the right direction.
这是个好的开始（还不够）
q: Your price is a bit high.
Your price is a bit expensive.
Your price is a bit costly.
Your price is a bit dear for money.
以下哪一句是「有条件的让步」？
If you can deliver by May, we could accept £1.12.

scenes.title: Answering Behavioural Questions
scenes.zh: 面试中回答行为类问题
scenes.note: 外企面试常问 Tell me about a time when...，建议用 STAR 结构回答：情境、任务、行动、结果。中国求职者常犯：全程只说 we，听不出自己做了什么；过度谦虚 I'm not good enough；被问 Do you have any questions? 时回答 No，显得缺乏兴趣。最好准备一两个关于岗位或团队的问题，第一个问题不要就问工资。
lines: 面试官 (Rachel Lim)
Can you tell me about a time when you had to deal with a difficult stakeholder?
能说说你曾经应对难缠的利益相关方的经历吗？
吴婷 (Wu Ting)

Sure. In my last role at a logistics firm in Shenzhen, I was coordinating a warehouse system upgrade. One of the regional managers was strongly against it because he was worried about downtime during peak season.
好的。我上一份工作在深圳一家物流公司，负责协调仓储系统升级。有位区域经理强烈反对，因为他担心旺季时系统停机。
面试官 (Rachel Lim)
How did you handle that?
你是怎么处理的？
吴婷 (Wu Ting)

I set up a one-to-one meeting to really understand his concerns. It turned out his main worry was the timing, not the system itself. So I proposed moving the go-live to a quieter month and running the old system in parallel for two weeks.
我约他单独面谈，认真了解他的顾虑。原来他主要担心的是时机，而不是系统本身。于是我提议把上线推到淡季，并让旧系统并行运行两周。
面试官 (Rachel Lim)
And what was the outcome?
结果如何？
吴婷 (Wu Ting)
He agreed to the new plan, and we launched with zero downtime. Order processing actually got about 15% faster. The main thing I took away was to listen first before trying to persuade.
他同意了新方案，我们零停机上线，订单处理速度还提高了约 15%。我最大的收获是：先倾听，再说服。
面试官 (Rachel Lim)
That's a great example. Do you have any questions for us?
很好的例子。你有什么问题想问我们吗？
吴婷 (Wu Ting)
Yes, actually. What would success look like in this role after the first six months?
有的。这个职位在头六个月里，怎样算是做得成功？
phr: Tell me about a time when ...
请讲讲你……的一次经历（行为面试题）
The main thing I took away was ...
What would success look like in this role?
这个职位怎样算做得成功？
q: 回答行为面试题常用的结构是？
面试官问 Do you have any questions for us? 最好的回答是？
Yes. What would success look like in this role?
No questions. When can I start?
How much is the salary? That's all.
The main thing I took away was... 的意思是？

scenes.title: Drinks After Work
scenes.note: 英国 pub 有「轮流请客」（buying rounds）的习惯，别人请了一轮，下一轮你要主动请。不喝酒点软饮完全没问题，也不要像国内饭局那样劝酒、干杯。闲聊避开工资、年龄、婚恋，天气、周末、美食是安全话题。Cheers 在英国除了「干杯」，还常表示「谢谢」或「再见」；想先走时说 I should make a move，比 I want to go home 自然。
lines: 同事 (Jack Turner)
A few of us are heading to the pub after work. Fancy coming along?
下班后我们几个要去酒吧，一起来吗？
郑浩 (Zheng Hao)
Yeah, why not? Let me just finish this email and I'll be right with you.
好啊，为什么不呢？我把这封邮件写完就来。
同事 (Jack Turner)
Right, it's my round. What are you having?
好，这轮我请。你喝什么？
郑浩 (Zheng Hao)
I'll have a half of the local ale, please. And I'll get the next one.
来半品脱本地艾尔吧。下一轮我请。
同事 (Jack Turner)
Deal. So, how are you finding London so far?
一言为定。你觉得伦敦怎么样？
郑浩 (Zheng Hao)
I'm loving it, though I'm still getting used to the weather!
非常喜欢，就是天气还没适应！
同事 (Jack Turner)
Ha, aren't we all? Been up to anything nice at the weekends?
哈，我们谁不是呢？周末有去哪儿玩吗？
郑浩 (Zheng Hao)
I went to Borough Market last Saturday. The food was amazing.
上周六去了博罗市场，吃的太棒了。
同事 (Jack Turner)
Good shout. You should try Columbia Road Flower Market on a Sunday, too.
选得好。周日你也该去哥伦比亚路花市看看。
郑浩 (Zheng Hao)
I'll have to check it out. Anyway, I should make a move — early start tomorrow. Cheers for tonight!
我一定去看看。好了，我得先走了，明天要早起。今晚谢谢啦！
phr: It's my round. / What are you having?
这轮我请 ／ 你喝什么？
好主意、选得好（英式口语）
q: It's my round. 的意思是？
英国同事离开时说 Cheers!，通常表示？
和同事闲聊时，比较安全的话题是？

scenes.title: Checking In at the Hotel
scenes.note: 入住时说 I have a reservation under + 姓。美国酒店通常会刷信用卡预授权，用于房费以外的杂费（incidentals），离店后解冻，不必紧张。How to go to...? 是典型中式英语，应说 How do I get to...?。纽约的 cab 是出租车，train 在这里指地铁线路。
lines: 前台 (Receptionist)
Good evening, welcome to the Lexington. Checking in?
晚上好，欢迎入住列克星敦酒店。办理入住吗？
马丽 (Ma Li)
Yes, I have a reservation under Ma, M-A. It was booked through my company, Northgate Analytics.
是的，我用「马」（M-A）这个姓预订的，是通过我公司诺斯盖特分析订的。
前台 (Receptionist)
Let me see... Yes, a king room for three nights. Could I see your passport and a credit card for incidentals?
我看一下……是的，大床房，住三晚。请出示护照和一张信用卡，用于杂费押金。
马丽 (Ma Li)
Here you go. Is breakfast included?
给您。含早餐吗？
前台 (Receptionist)
It is. It's served from 6:30 to 10 on the second floor.
含的。早上 6 点半到 10 点在二楼供应。
马丽 (Ma Li)
Great. And is there somewhere I can print some documents for a meeting tomorrow?
太好了。有地方可以打印明天开会用的文件吗？
前台 (Receptionist)
Yes, our business center is open 24 hours. Here's your key card — you're in room 1208.
有，我们的商务中心 24 小时开放。这是您的房卡，房间是 1208。
马丽 (Ma Li)
Thanks. One more thing — how long does it take to get to Hudson Yards from here?
谢谢。还有一件事，从这里到哈德逊园区要多久？
前台 (Receptionist)
About fifteen minutes by cab, or you can take the 7 train from Grand Central.
打车大约十五分钟，也可以在中央车站坐 7 号线。
马丽 (Ma Li)
Perfect, thank you.
好的，谢谢。
phr: 用于杂费押金的信用卡
How long does it take to get to ...?
q: How do I get to Hudson Yards?
How to go to Hudson Yards?
How can I go Hudson Yards?
Where is the way to go Hudson Yards?
I have a reservation under Ma.
I have a reservation of name Ma.
My reservation name is called Ma.

scenes.title: Apologising to a Client
scenes.zh: 因账单错误向客户道歉
scenes.note: 向客户道歉：承认错误、简短说明原因、给出补救和预防措施。中国人常把责任推给系统或同事，或反复说 sorry 却没有方案。Sorry to make you trouble 不地道，可说 Sorry for the confusion。结尾说 Thanks for your patience 比再说一遍 sorry 更专业。
lines: 唐雯 (Tang Wen)
Marcus, thanks for taking my call. I'm calling about the invoice we sent last week. I'm afraid there was an error on our side — you were charged for 600 cases instead of 500.
马库斯，谢谢你接电话。我打来是关于上周发给你们的发票。很抱歉，是我们这边出了错：多收了 600 箱的钱，实际是 500 箱。
客户 (Marcus Lee)
Ah, I was wondering about that. Our finance team flagged it this morning.
啊，我正纳闷呢。我们财务今天早上提出来了。
唐雯 (Tang Wen)
I'm really sorry for the confusion. It was a data entry mistake, and I take full responsibility.
给你们造成困扰，真的很抱歉。这是录入错误，我负全部责任。
客户 (Marcus Lee)
These things happen. What's the next step?
难免的。下一步怎么办？
唐雯 (Tang Wen)
We'll issue a corrected invoice today, and if you've already paid, we'll refund the difference within three working days.
我们今天就开更正后的发票；如果你们已经付款，三个工作日内退还差额。
客户 (Marcus Lee)
We haven't paid yet, so a corrected invoice is fine.
我们还没付，开张更正发票就行。
唐雯 (Tang Wen)
Great. We've also added an extra check to our billing process so this doesn't happen again.
好的。我们也在开票流程里加了一道核对，避免再出这种问题。
客户 (Marcus Lee)
I appreciate you letting us know so quickly.
谢谢你们这么快通知我们。
唐雯 (Tang Wen)
Of course. Thanks for your patience, Marcus.
应该的。谢谢你的耐心，马库斯。
phr: I'm afraid there was an error on our side.
很抱歉，是我们这边出了错
I'm really sorry for the confusion.
给您造成困扰，非常抱歉
q: 给客户道歉时，最得体的是？
I'm sorry — it was our mistake, and we'll fix it today.
It's not my fault. The system was wrong.
refund the difference 的意思是？
道歉的结尾，比再说一次 sorry 更好的是？
